**Critical-path item** (from `docs/CRITICAL-PATH.md`):

**Hypothesis**

**Falsifier** (the cheap attack or measurement that would kill it)

**Profiles and scope** (sizes, field/primitive, CPU/GPU, matched domains)

**Budget and stop criterion** (time / cost / number of samples, and when to stop)

**Evidence to record** (hashes, seeds, raw data, failures, censored outcomes)

**Expected decision value** (how the result changes the A-vs-B answer)
